spec_match.rationale: Ten real teardown paths (remove, ancestor, innerHTML, replaceChildren, replaceWith, object, nested grandchild, opaque sandbox, plus navigation and moveBefore controls) mirror the compat study's sanity patterns.

interactive.rationale: Run-all plus per-card run buttons and a live summary.

blurb_alignment.rationale: Matches the index card's inspection-tool description.

edge_cases.rationale: Includes an out-of-scope opaque sandbox row and two controls whose disagreement flags the harness as untrustworthy. moveBefore absence is reported as skipped.

references.rationale: Links chromestatus.com/feature/<id> plus the spec/explainer sections it exercises.

conformance.rationale: Feeds the suite's ancestor-removal script assertion and the manual opaque-scope assertion.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Headless Chromium 153.0.8010.12 (Playwright) at 1280x800 and 360x740 DPR3 touch: 7/7 in-scope paths showed synchronous events (deprecated); sandbox row delivered events asynchronously via postMessage; navigation control fired after the call; moveBefore fired nothing; zero page errors; only aborted subresource loads of removed frames. Flagged branch not observable on 153.

telemetry_health.rationale: One assertion per path, failing on unexpected/error outcomes.

design_system.rationale: CSS variables only; buttons override both background and color; verdict colours use emerald-dark/rose on stone; no raw hex.

accessibility.rationale: Each card is a list item with a heading, definition list and labelled run button. The observation dd is aria-live, and scratch frames are offscreen, inert and aria-hidden so they leak no focus.

mobile_desktop_parity.rationale: Card grid collapses to one column at 360px with 0px overflow.

openQuestions.title: Add a cross-origin OOPIF row
openQuestions.detail: The live site has a single origin. A second origin (or a sidecar on another host) would allow the compat study's cross-origin and A1→B→A2 sandwich cases, which separate Option 2a from Option 2b.

guidanceConsulted.query: responsive control panel without horizontal overflow mobile
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use intrinsic grid tracks (minmax(min(100%, Xrem), 1fr)) and wrap long monospace strings so nothing overflows at 360px.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Card grids use minmax(min(100%,…),1fr); outputs use overflow-wrap:anywhere; measured 0px horizontal overflow at 360x740 DPR3.

guidanceConsulted.query: accessible status live region announce async result
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Announce asynchronous results via polite live regions; keep native buttons/labels; visible focus.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Verdicts/outputs are role=status or aria-live=polite; all controls are native buttons/inputs with visible text labels and a 3px focus outline; min 44px targets.

guidanceConsulted.query: iframe lifecycle pagehide visibilitychange unload deprecation
guidanceConsulted.recommendation: Use Element.moveBefore() (feature-detected, insertBefore fallback) to reparent iframes without reload/state loss.
guidanceConsulted.appliedOrException: Used as the control row / advanced composition, feature-detected with an explained disabled state.

summary: A faithful inspection grid of real removal paths with built-in controls. Flagged-browser evidence is still pending.
